title: Anonymous requests to public pages skip the Supabase auth call in the proxy
detail:
proxy.ts:143 runs supabase.auth.getUser() on every request including ISR marketing and crawlers. Exit early when no auth cookie is present. Estimated 50-150 ms TTFB; measure first.

Proxy skips getUser without a Supabase auth cookie (#3931). TTFB lift unmeasured.

verify.note: Exits 0 only when the repair has landed; fails on main today.
